preconditions.description: The number of tasks q must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= 100000 for t_i, u_i in tasks if t_i == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 tasks, the number u_i must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= 100000 and 1 <= k_i <= 100000 and 1 <= s_i <= 100000 for t_i, x_i, k_i, s_i in tasks if t_i == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 tasks, x_i, k_i, and s_i must all be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(v for v in a if k_i % gcd(x_i, v) == 0 and x_i + v <= s_i) else str(max(v for v in a if k_i % gcd(x_i, v) == 0 and x_i + v <= s_i))
postconditions.description: For type 2 tasks, output the maximum v that satisfies the conditions or -1 if no such v exists.
